theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_fcp_locally_planar_is_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)), 2 ≤ m → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M.Nonempty → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ H : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H = m ∧ H ≤ A₀ ∧ ∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ x ∈ O ∧ O ∩ M = O ∩ (H : Set (Euclid P))) → ∃ H₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m ∧ M = (H₀ : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}
